title: 4.5 dev 5 crash on win11 nvidia except opengl3
body:
### Tested versions

reproducable in 4.5 dev 5
not reproducable in previous versions including 4.5 dev 4

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev5 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7652) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

trying to open an old or creating a new project crashes when creating the editor window on 4.5 dev 5. it's not reproducable on dev 4, it opens successfully. it's not the expired certificate, i think it's vulkan. it works if i force the renderer to opengl3 with command line. i have a 4070 ti with driver version 576.52 whql. here is the verbose log:
